correctness.rationale: Center any contained rectangle by convex symmetric averaging. For centered rectangles, opposite vertex pairs on a radius-rho circle are allowed in two symmetric arcs of half-angle theta(rho), decreasing in rho. Square sector theta>=pi/4 is bounded by the critical axis-aligned square, and theta<pi/4 has unique maximal angular separation at axis-parallel corners. Optimize f(u)=4(a+u)sqrt(r²-u²) with critical 2u²+au=r² and prove uniqueness by strict circular-cap boundary curvature. Substitute s=1/t-2t into J=M/P²; independent symbolic differentiation verified derivative sign switches only at t=2/pi and constant 1/(8sqrt(pi²-4)); the filling-fraction derivative is strictly negative in t, hence increasing in s. Includes a>0 uniqueness and a=0 rotated-square boundary.
